title: Book Three · Chapter 139: Two Different Envelopes
story:
On Monday, Ronan finishes his twentieth letter to Leo after school.

He starts with Jun and the football game. He draws a very small goal and a ball far beyond it.

Then he tells Leo about the training centre. He copies one line from the practice note and explains the changed date.

I liked that afternoon, he writes. There are lessons with numbers too. I need to find out more.

He adds one last question about Leo's own term. Then he signs the page and folds it into an envelope.

The next letter is for the local centre. Ronan puts its address beside his clean sheet.

He asks about the class times and the fee. He also asks about the work inside the lessons.

What do students practise in class?

He looks at that question, then adds another about the next starting date.

Mum comes over with her tea. He shows her the short request.

“Are you choosing now?” she asks.

“I want the dates first. And the cost.”

She reads the questions once.

“You still have your school work.”

“I know. That needs time too.”

She gives him the page back. There is a tea mark on the table near his elbow. He moves the letter away before he folds it. He keeps a copy of the course questions. The original goes inside the second envelope.

Kai knocks at the open door. He has brought his own ball and wants a few passes in the park.

“Two letters?” he asks.

“Different places.”

“Does Leo need two copies of your goal?”

Ronan laughs and shows him the little drawing before he closes the first envelope.

He writes the two addresses, then turns each envelope over to check it. Leo's goes on top. The centre's goes below.

“I need to post them first,” he tells Kai.

“I can walk.”

At the post office, Ronan pays for both stamps from his separate spending money. The twenty-one yuan from work stays at home.

He posts both letters. Then he and Kai walk to the park with the ball.

They have time for a few passes before dinner. Ronan stops the first one, but Kai's next kick sends the ball close to the far corner.

“There,” Ronan says. “The place in my drawing.”

Kai laughs and runs after it. Ronan leaves his bag beside the path. Then he moves onto the grass to meet the next pass.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

request＝请求、询问；starting date＝开始日期；elbow＝手肘；stamp＝邮票。

## 理解问题

1. 两封信各寄给谁？哪一封是给Leo的第二十封？
2. Ronan为什么先问日期和费用？邮票有没有从工资信封扣钱？

## 读句子

**He posts both letters.**

拆开看：He / posts / both letters.

他／寄出／这两封信。
